title: 第25章 盒武器龙虎丹第26章 白嫖和你牛大了
content_zh:
‘终于闲下来了。’
深夜，叶离练武洗漱完毕。
躺在自己简陋的屋内，望着天花板静静发呆。
今天一天发生的事情实在太多，确实要消化所得。
先是突破淬体境，然后拳打卢岳三人，脚踩李熙面颊。
随后又在城东拿了一套房，并在冯越的讲解下解锁了全区地图。
短短一天的经历，硬是让作者水了8章，太狗了！
得益于前世的习惯，叶离习惯睡前每日对信息进行归纳总结。
首先是地图扩大，反正如今的自己是无名小卒，倒是不必担心大势力觊觎的问题。
只要好好维持地方小天才的人设，先一路修行到后天，再考虑接下来换地图的事。
然后便是修行！
如今核心弟子的保障太虚了，还要找一个靠山来作为保障，起码要让李家那边不敢动他。
同时修炼的事也不能落下，争取三个月内突破淬体中期！
……
在脑中暗暗根据目前可公开情报定下计划，叶离这才心满意足地换了个舒服的姿势睡眠。
但他所不知的是，此刻的中州，正因为他的存在，而略微掀起涟漪。
这涟漪，正是因为橙色词条【追因溯果】造成的。
与外界描述的信息一致，作为最强情报词条，【追因溯果】的能力必须以媒介作因，才能推出结果！
越是详细的因，所推断的结果越是详细，最强甚至可以望断古今。
若是在大庆境内，详细到降雨的点数，甚至是个人的所思所想，都可以借此算得。

但在大庆之外，其算力就不够丰富，必须有足够的媒介，才能触发。
比方说……言语！
这也是，大庆主动向外传播自家词条的缘故。
只要让全天下人人讨论，一张遍布天地的因果大网便能让王朝趋吉避凶！
所以当今天，冯越主动向叶离谈论起这个词条时，二人的对话直接触动到因果链条最细微的末端。
四个时辰前，捕捉到关键词的司天监中心玲珑宝塔内自动吐出一张轻薄如无物的白纸。
一名头戴束冠，值守此处的青袍官员信手拈来，目光扫过纸面上由星辉勾勒出的几行小字后，面色立刻变得严肃：
“立刻禀报监正，南蛮地域有人疑似觉醒金色词条！请龙虎山立刻展开卜算，务必寻到详细位置！将之纳入我朝麾下！”
得到命令的官员脸色露出为难道：“那金色词条仅是谈及大庆，这点媒介展开卜算，目标和结果定然相差万里！”
青袍官员摇头道：“总要努力一番，金色词条有改天换地之潜能，若不能为大庆效劳，也要将其扼杀在摇篮之中！”
“现在只期盼，南蛮那些大派不会先我们一步将那词条纳入掌中。”
“若是被大派用术法神通惑了心智，对大庆又是一番巨大威胁！”
命令迅速传递，没有延误！
一刻钟后，经过层层传阅，一纸盖着司天监大印的加急文书，由掌印太监亲自携带，化作流光向城外而去。
距大庆京都万里之遥，一处云雾缭绕的山巅道观外，道童稽首：
“天师已然知晓，即刻展开卜算，无论结果如何，皆需七日七夜时间，且希望渺茫，请足下耐心等待！”
宫中掌印太监肃然回礼：“无论结果，都有劳道长了！”
……
第二日，叶离神清气爽的翻身下床。
他完全不知道，远在中州竟然因为自己的存在，而掀起无数波澜。

清醒后，他的第一想法便是按照昨晚冯越的教导，向着城东的回春巷而去。
content_en:
‘I’m finally free. ’
Late at night, Ye Li finished his martial arts practice and washed up.
Lying in his humble house, staring at the ceiling in silence.
Too many things happened today, and we really have to digest them.
First, he broke through the body tempering realm, then punched Lu Yue and the other three, and stepped on Li Xi's cheek.
Then he got a house in the east of the city and unlocked the map of the whole area under Feng Yue's explanation.
In just one day's experience, the author was stunned for 8 chapters. It's so stupid!
Thanks to the habits of his previous life, Ye Li is used to summarizing information every day before going to bed.
The first is the expansion of the map. Anyway, now that I am a nobody, I don’t have to worry about the big forces coveting me.
As long as you maintain the character of the local little genius, practice all the way until the day after tomorrow, and then think about changing the map next.
Then comes the practice!
Nowadays, the core disciples' protection is too weak, and they need to find a backer as a guarantee, at least to make the Li family dare not touch him.
At the same time, we must not neglect our cultivation, and strive to break through to the middle stage of body tempering within three months!
…
After secretly making a plan in his mind based on the currently available information, Ye Li contentedly changed into a comfortable position to sleep.
But what he didn't know was that Zhongzhou was causing slight ripples because of his presence.
This ripple is caused by the orange entry [Tracing Cause and Effect].
Consistent with the information described by the outside world, as the strongest intelligence entry, the ability to [trace cause and effect] must use the media as the cause to deduce the result!
The more detailed the cause, the more detailed the inferred result, and the strongest one can even predict the past and present.
If you are in Daqing, you can calculate everything down to the number of rainfall points and even personal thoughts.
But outside Daqing, its computing power is not rich enough, and there must be enough media to trigger it.
Like...words!
This is also the reason why Daqing takes the initiative to spread its own entries to the outside world.
As long as everyone in the world discusses it, a huge network of cause and effect spread all over the world can make the dynasty seek good fortune and avoid misfortune!
So today, when Feng Yue took the initiative to talk about this entry to Ye Li, the conversation between the two directly touched the smallest end of the causal chain.
Four hours ago, a piece of white paper, as thin as nothing, was automatically spit out from the exquisite pagoda in the center of Si Tianjian after capturing the keyword.
A green-robed official wearing a crown and guarding the place came over with ease. After his eyes glanced at a few lines of small characters outlined by stars on the paper, his expression immediately became serious:
"Immediately report to the supervisor that there is someone in the Southern Barbarian area who is suspected of awakening the golden entry! Please start a divination in Longhu Mountain immediately and be sure to find the detailed location! Bring him under our command!"
The official who received the order had a confused look on his face: "The golden entry only talks about Daqing. If the media starts a divination, the goal and the result will definitely be thousands of miles apart!"
The green-robed official shook his head and said: "We must work hard. The golden entries have the potential to change the world. If we cannot serve Daqing, we must nip it in the cradle!"
"Now we just hope that the big factions of the Southern Barbarians will not take that entry into their hands before we do."
"If the big sect uses magic and magical powers to confuse the mind, it will be a huge threat to Daqing!"
Orders are delivered quickly with no delays!
A quarter of an hour later, after being circulated at all levels, an urgent document with the seal of Si Tianjian was personally carried by the eunuch with the palm seal, and turned into a stream of light and headed out of the city.
Thousands of miles away from Daqing and Kyoto, outside a Taoist temple on a mountaintop shrouded in clouds and mist, a Taoist boy bowed his head:
"The Heavenly Master is aware of this and will immediately start divination. No matter what the outcome is, it will take seven days and seven nights, and the hope is slim. Please wait patiently!"
The eunuch in charge of the palace responded solemnly: "No matter the result, I have thanked you, Taoist Priest!"
…
On the second day, Ye Li got out of bed feeling refreshed.
He had no idea that his presence in Zhongzhou would cause countless waves.
After waking up, his first thought wasFollowing Feng Yue's instructions last night, he headed towards Huichun Lane in the east of the city.
